stories.title: VÍDEOS: Bom Dia Goiás desta segunda-feira, 28 de setembro de 2026

en.title: VIDEOS: Good Morning Goiás from Monday, September 28, 2026
en.summary: A compilation of news reports from the morning news program Good Morning Goiás.

stories.title: Acidente na BR-262 deixa ao menos 9 mortos no Espírito Santo

en.title: Accident on BR-262 leaves at least 9 dead in Espírito Santo
en.summary: An accident occurred on BR-262 in the state of Espírito Santo, resulting in at least 9 deaths.

stories.title: Anvisa aprova registro de medicamento para diabetes que combina insulina e semaglutida

en.title: Anvisa approves registration of diabetes medication combining insulin and semaglutide
en.summary: Brazil's health agency approved Kyinsu, a Novo Nordisk medication combining icodeca insulin and semaglutide for treating type 2 diabetes.

stories.title: Inscrições para concurso da Defensoria Pública da Paraíba, com salários acima de R$ 5 mil, começam nesta segunda-feira (28)

en.title: Applications for Public Defenders' Office of Paraíba competition, with salaries above R$ 5,000, begin this Monday (28)
en.summary: Applications opened for a Public Defenders' Office competition in Paraíba offering 20 positions at middle and upper levels, with salaries ranging from R$ 4,042.50 to R$ 5,197.50.

stories.title: Acidente com ônibus deixa 3 mortos e 44 feridos na BR-262 no Espírito Santo

en.title: Bus accident kills 3 and injures 44 on BR-262 in Espírito Santo
en.summary: A tourism bus crashed on a Brazilian highway early Monday, resulting in three deaths and 44 injuries. The accident occurred on a section known as Ferradura Curve in the Caparaó region.

stories.title: Governo Lula barra insulina sem registro da Anvisa, mas contrata laboratório sem aval do órgão

en.title: Lula government blocks unregistered insulin from Anvisa, but hires laboratory without agency approval
en.summary: The Brazilian government rejected insulin without regulatory approval while simultaneously contracting a laboratory that also lacks authorization from the health agency.

stories.title: Kassio prepara reação à decisão de Dino sobre Nossa Senhora e vai cobrar de Fachin medida contra manipulação

en.title: Kassio prepares response to Dino's decision on Nossa Senhora and will demand action from Fachin against manipulation
en.summary: The head of Brazil's electoral court plans to react to a Supreme Court minister's decision allowing social media posts about a political controversy, challenging the electoral court's previous order.

stories.title: Notícia no Seu Tempo: Dino anula decisão de Mendonça e libera posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio contra Nossa Senhora

en.title: Dino annuls Mendonça's decision and releases posts about false support from Flávio regarding Nossa Senhora
en.summary: A Supreme Court minister reversed a previous decision and allowed social media posts regarding an alleged political endorsement related to Nossa Senhora Aparecida.

stories.title: Ministro de Lula repudia fala de Flávio sobre CNBB ajudar em fake news sobre Nossa Senhora Aparecida

en.title: Lula's minister rejects Flávio's claim that CNBB helped spread fake news about Nossa Senhora Aparecida
en.summary: A minister in Lula's government contested Flávio Bolsonaro's accusations that the National Conference of Bishops assisted in creating false reports about the patron saint.

stories.title: Lula tenta explorar notícia falsa sobre ‘Nossa Senhora’ e é contestado: ‘fake news, né, presidente?’

en.title: Lula attempts to exploit false news about 'Nossa Senhora' and is challenged: 'fake news, right, president?'
en.summary: President Lula faced criticism for attempting to leverage misinformation regarding Nossa Senhora Aparecida, with opponents questioning his claims about the false reports.

stories.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça e libera post sobre Nossa Senhora

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision and allows post about Nossa Senhora
en.summary: Supreme Court minister Flávio Dino reversed another judge's decision to remove a social media post about Nossa Senhora Aparecida by a comedian that contained political commentary.

stories.title: Dino derruba decisão de Mendonça que removeu posts sobre falso apoio de Flávio a ‘tirar padroeira’

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision that removed posts about false support from Flávio to 'remove patron saint'
en.summary: Justice Minister Dino reversed a previous ruling that had removed social media posts regarding a political support matter involving a religious figure.

stories.title: Maioria das empresas no Simples deve optar por alíquotas cheias do IBS e CBS, dizem especialistas

en.title: Most companies in Simples should opt for full IBS and CBS rates, say experts
en.summary: Tax specialists believe that most businesses enrolled in the simplified tax regime will choose to apply the full rates for the new IBS and CBS taxes.

stories.title: Sudeste tem maior proporção de população 60+

en.title: Southeast has highest proportion of population 60+
en.summary: The Southeast region of Brazil has the largest share of residents aged 60 and older compared to other regions.

stories.title: Pandas cedidos pela China chegam aos EUA

en.title: Pandas loaned by China arrive in the United States
en.summary: Giant pandas given by China as part of a diplomatic loan have arrived in the United States.

stories.title: Desenrola 3.0 tem cronograma apertado, mas deve ser positivo para bancos

en.title: Desenrola 3.0 has tight schedule, but should be positive for banks
en.summary: Brazil's new debt renegotiation program has an accelerated timeline with the first auction planned for November, though banking sector sources expect favorable outcomes despite operational uncertainties.

stories.title: Dino anula decisão de Mendonça no TSE e libera posts sobre Aparecida

en.title: Dino overturns Mendonça's decision at TSE and allows posts about Aparecida
en.summary: A judicial decision by Mendonça at Brazil's electoral court was reversed by Dino, resulting in the authorization of posts related to Aparecida.
